organization: Federal Supreme Court of Switzerland (Bundesgericht / Tribunal fédéral)
description: Elected a federal judge by the United Federal Assembly on 25 September 2019, according to her Federal Supreme Court biography. As of October 2026 the Court's roster lists her as a judge of the Second Criminal Law Division (juge fédérale à la deuxième Cour de droit pénal). On 19 September 2023 she presided over the panel of that division in cases 7B_15/2021 and 7B_16/2021 (see polemics).
